compute_moving_average: compute a moving average over a numpy array with a configurable window size
calculate_te_drift: calculate the total energy drift in meV/atom/ps from an NVE MD trajectory file
join_nvemd_results: join total energy drift results from multiple NVE MD trajectory files into a list
compute_nvemd_metrics: compute the mean drift metric as a pandas DataFrame from a list of drift values
save_nvemd_results: save a list of NVE MD drift results to a text file in the results directory
